title: 23 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Performs the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis of BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandirs (sanskardhams) for Memnagar and Odhav suburbs
story:
During the inauguration of Hiramani Chhatralay (school hostel) and then blesses the assembly

Blesses the satsang assembly

In a jovial mood during an assembly

Performs arti of Shakotsav

Arrives for darshan at the historic Ambli Vali Pol

Morning puja

Departs from Ambli Vali Pol

At the Ambli Vali Pol

K.K. Shastri and Devkinandan Dwivedi light the traditional lamp to inaugurate the Golden Anniversary conference of the Akhil Bharatiya Darshan Parishad at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir, Amdavad

On stage during the inaugural session

Performs arti

Variety of fresh vegetables offered to Thakorji on Kartak sud Ekadashi (Shakotsav)

Balaks with Bapa after their performance

After concluding his morning puja, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of deities to
be installed in BAPS hari mandirs in Memnagar (Amdavad), Odhav (Amdavad), Khoraj and Sector 22, Gandhinagar.

At about 10.00 am Swamishri performed the foundation-stone laying ceremony of ‘Jivan Sandhya Kutir’ (home for senior citizens) and also
inaugurated the newly built student’s hostel called ‘Ishavasyam Chhatralay’ of Hiramani Vidyalay in Chharodi on the outskirts of Amdavad. Thereafter
Swamishri addressed the assembly of dignitaries and blessed Shri Narharibhai Amin, the president and proprietor of the Hiramani Educational Trust.

options.story:
Engrossed in darshan of Thakorji. Performs the morning arti. Performs his daily puja. Blesses a child.

Greets bhaktas with 'Jai Swaminarayan'. Engrossed in darshan of Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. Engrossed in darshan in the room of gurus Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Bapa and sadguru sadhus on stage during the assembly.

Engrossed in darshan of Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj. Visits the shrine of Purushottamdas Swami (Khandeshi). Bapa and sadhus perform abhishek of Shri Nilkanth Varni. Engrossed in the darshan of a cart sanctified by Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj.

In the mandir grounds. Blesses children and youths. Blesses children. Pujya Doctor Swami and Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami perform the evening arti.

Bhaktas during the assembly. Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami addresses the assembly. Pujya Bhaktipriya Swami (Kothari Swami) addresses the assembly. Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami addresses the assembly.

Pujya Swayamprakash Swami (Doctor Swami) addresses the assembly. Youths perform a traditional dance.

The blade of grass

Mahant Swami Maharaj was going from his residence towards the dining hut when Kikani Saheb was standing on the path with two rudraksha saplings. He requested Swamishri, "Place flowers on these and sanctify them. We will plant them here."

Swamishri's eyes fell on the saplings, and immediately drawing attention to it, he said, "Pull out that blade of grass."

A small blade of grass had sprouted from the black bag of one sapling. The sadhus marvelled at Swamishri's keen eye.
